criteria.detail: Root and expanded-child rows use BB's lazy PR hook and render UrlLink metadata with a semantic pill, number, and truncated title. No supplied screenshot contains a live PR, so PR visuals are supported by wiring and contract evidence rather than claimed from screenshots.

The deterministic mapper covers Draft, Changes, all three Blocked inputs, Checks, In review, Ready, Merged, Closed, and Open using semantic theme-token classes; the repaired unit matrix includes explicit blocked attention.
Child PR lookup remains inside ChildThreadRow, mounted only for expanded families; missing/loading PR data adds no PR line and leaves location, time, status, and navigation intact.

Done metadata requires a non-null normalized final output and yields to PR metadata. The wide capture visibly shows truthful one-line DONE summaries for all three completed demo children, with compact truncation also visible.

The strict typed RPC accepts bounded unique batches, revalidates quiet status and timestamp, normalizes C0/C1 controls and whitespace to at most 120 characters, and uses a 200-entry process-memory timestamp-keyed LRU cleared on deletion.

The controlled capture visibly shows one Waiting for agents line with one activity glyph, a working child, and matching primary-tinted vertical and active horizontal connector segments. The completed capture shows the connector returned to neutral; no project-level status icon was added.

Source preserves waiting at family level, PR-over-Done row precedence, and existing status/location/time/provider/current-row treatments. Controlled evidence visibly retains authoritative root and child Working labels alongside the waiting signal.
Changes remain localized to metadata and connector behavior; all 155 Dockside tests pass, while wide and 320px captures preserve hierarchy, project controls, compact layout, and clean truncation.

Fresh unit, fault-injection, typecheck, and live-system receipts all pass on one tree digest. Tests cover every named PR state, C0/C1 normalization, default 120-character truncation, nullable LRU behavior and deletion invalidation; live captures show three Done summaries and the controlled waiting/tinted-connector state. No PR was visible, so only native PR wiring is asserted.

summary: All acceptance criteria pass after the repairs. The new tests close the blocked and normalization-boundary gaps, and the dedicated controlled screenshot directly demonstrates Waiting for agents plus connector tint while the earlier capture demonstrates neutral completed-state behavior.
